# verify-delivery refused, and it was right

After the review record was written at 23, I added `.env.example` to the tree and committed it. It is
four lines of documentation, it is harmless, and it was never reviewed. `verify-delivery` compared
the tree against the fingerprint review had attested, found the difference, and refused.

The file is removed rather than the gate overridden. Documentation of where a credential goes belongs
to SEEN-090, which owns the security controls, and it will be reviewed there. What gets delivered
here is exactly what was reviewed, which is the only claim a receipt is able to make.
